title: UK Official Vows 'Relentless' Action on Small Boat Migrant Crossings
summary: UK's Mayor of Greater Manchester, Andy Burnham, has pledged to be "relentless" in tackling small boat crossings of migrants. Following a visit to Dover, Burnham stated the UK needs to "bring back that control." He also indicated that safe routes for refugees are necessary to combat trafficking. The comments came after tens of thousands of migrants entered the Spanish territory of Ceuta.
summary_points: Andy Burnham, Mayor of Greater Manchester, vowed to be 'relentless' on small boat migrant crossings.
Burnham made the pledge after visiting Dover.
He stated the UK must 'bring back that control'.
Burnham also said safe routes for refugees are needed to tackle trafficking.
The comments followed a large influx of migrants into Spain's Ceuta territory.
